policy.description: Blocking line-coverage ratchets. For a fixed scope, coveredLines is the highest value in the reviewed clean-run observation envelope, never a modal or repeated lower value, and that high-water never decreases. Update the envelope in the same reviewed change whenever scope or coverage advances. A fixed-scope floor may move downward only to the exact minimum directly observed by clean runs on the identical source, tests, and total-line scope, with linked evidence and a bounded tolerance; unexplained coverage loss remains a regression.

tolerance.rationale: Issue #709 established this exact 3,359-line core scope and 2,974-line reviewed high-water. Issue #715 adds qBittorrent telemetry outside src/core and extends the final review tree with account-transition, timestamp, polling, and transport/session regressions without changing that instrumented scope. Two clean full client runs on the exact final issue #715 source passed all 270 files and 2,588 tests and both measured 2,974/3,359 (88.538%) without instrumentation spread. The reviewed observed high-water and exact observed floor therefore remain 2,974/3,359 with zero tolerance. coverage-baseline.test.js retains the exact below-floor, above-baseline, scope-change, observed-high-water, and broad-tolerance negative boundaries.

Issue #715 adds bounded, read-only qBittorrent telemetry, caller-scoped authorization, secret-safe administration, deterministic path ownership, and the associated transport, lifecycle, security, and architecture tests on top of the issue #711 and #716 mainline. The terminal review fixes retain the SID from a legacy HTTP 200 login before any bounded body read can fail so every owned session is logged out with the same cookie, and add exact malformed, oversized, and throwing-body regressions. Three clean canonical local .NET SDK 10.0.109/runtime 10.0.9 full-suite runs on this exact 55,635-line source and 4,373-test scope passed every test and measured 45,734/55,635 (82.203649%), 45,733/55,635 (82.201851%), and 45,730/55,635 (82.196459%). GitHub Actions run 31898946053, Unit job 95046467875, then passed the same 4,373/4,373 tests at exact head a6faa6faa35b140049bd276468d4114b67db2fa3 and measured 45,740/55,635 (82.214433%); its sole failure was the expected stale-baseline rejection above 45,734. The reviewed observed high-water is therefore 45,740/55,635 and the exact observed floor remains 45,730/55,635; the ten-line instrumentation spread is 0.017974 percentage points, within the 0.15-point policy maximum. A pre-test invocation with an unsupported Node toolchain and two runs that passed only 4,372/4,373 tests were excluded, as was the separate clean coverage-enabled TRX diagnostic because it was not one of the canonical envelope runs. The prior issue #715 observations remain evidence for the earlier 55,622-line scope and are not mixed into this changed-scope envelope. coverage-baseline.test.js retains the exact scope-drift, regression, stale-baseline, observed-high-water, spread, single-run, and broad-tolerance negative boundaries.
